metadata.title: Universal Classes
metadata.purpose: Canonical twenty-two-class roster, complete level progressions, subclasses, transition notes, and class-specific mechanics without duplicated spell lists or shared Ichor rules.

rules_priority: Session Zero agreements and safety boundaries

starting_and_multiclass_rules.subclass_level_handling: Subclass level is not counted separately from class level; subclass features are embedded in the class levels. A 'Necromancy Wizard 5' therefore means primary_class_level=5, subclass=Necromancy, not 10 levels.

post_level_8_balance_policy.example_grace_rule: Your example allows a level 8 split of 5/3 and allows level 9 to be either primary or secondary. If a secondary level causes the lead to fall below 3, set primary_catch_up_required=true and require primary-class levels until the lead is at least 3 again.

level_up_examples.reason: Matches user's example grace; strict gap is not yet restored.
Required after taking secondary at level 9; strict gap still below 3.
Strict primary lead of 3 is restored.

validator_pseudocode: if character.secondaryClass is null: return true
if character.totalLevel == 8: return chosenClass in [primaryClass, secondaryClass]
if character.primaryCatchUpRequired and chosenClass != primaryClass: return false
if chosenClass == secondaryClass and newPrimary - newSecondary < 3: allow only if DMExampleGrace is enabled, then set primaryCatchUpRequired=true
after applying the level, set primaryCatchUpRequired = (newPrimary - newSecondary < 3)

universal_class_rules.rules_target: D&D 5e / 2024-compatible homebrew using standard d20 math and action economy.
universal_class_rules.proficiency_bonus: Use total character level: +2 at levels 1–4, +3 at 5–8, +4 at 9–12, +5 at 13–16, +6 at 17–20.
universal_class_rules.class_feature_save_dc: 8 + proficiency bonus + the subclass spellcasting ability modifier; non-casters use the class primary mental ability listed in the chassis.
universal_class_rules.class_feature_attack_bonus: proficiency bonus + the relevant Strength, Dexterity, or spellcasting ability modifier.
universal_class_rules.action_economy: Use the Covenant Engine: 3 Beats and 1 Reaction. Translate movement to 1 Beat, an action to 2 Beats, a bonus action to 1 Swift Beat, and an action-plus-bonus-action feature to 3 Beats.
universal_class_rules.concentration: A creature can concentrate on only one effect requiring concentration. Damage triggers a Constitution saving throw with DC 10 or half the damage taken, whichever is higher.
universal_class_rules.extra_attack: Extra Attack never stacks with another Extra Attack feature. The character uses the highest number of attacks granted by any one feature.
universal_class_rules.spellcasting: A spell uses its printed casting time, range, components, duration, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules unless a class feature explicitly changes one of them.
universal_class_rules.resource_floor: Bounty Ichor cannot exceed its maximum and cannot fall below 0. A bounty trigger can restore at most 1 Ichor per round, and a single creature or event cannot be farmed repeatedly.
universal_class_rules.thundercoils: Thundercoils follow normal weapon proficiency and attack rules. Their charges, heat, Overload, instability, and maintenance are separate from Bounty Ichor unless a feature explicitly connects them.
universal_class_rules.multiclassing: For multiclass spell slots, a half-caster path contributes half its class levels rounded down after the path is chosen; a full-caster path contributes its class levels minus 2, minimum 0. A non-caster path contributes none.
universal_class_rules.rest_terminology: A printed short rest is a Field Rest; a printed long rest is a Haven Rest.

melee_non_caster.rule: This path has no class spellcasting. Ichor manifestations and Thundercoil effects are class features, not spells, unless an effect says otherwise.

half_caster.slot_progression: Universal shifted half-caster table beginning at class level 3.
half_caster.preparation_formula: Prepare a number of class spells equal to the spellcasting ability modifier + half the class level rounded down (minimum 1).
half_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one listed D&D parent-class spell list, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

full_caster.slot_progression: Full-caster slot table delayed until subclass selection at class level 3; class level 3 uses the standard level-1 full-caster row.
full_caster.cantrips_known: 3 at class level 3, 4 at level 10, and 5 at level 17.
full_caster.preparation_formula: Prepare a number of class spells equal to the spellcasting ability modifier + (class level − 2), minimum 1.
full_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one listed D&D parent-class spell list, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

derecho_death_dealer.name: Derecho Death Dealer
derecho_death_dealer.description: A necrotic storm-warrior who fights inside violent weather, channels the dead through weapons, and grows more dangerous as creatures fall nearby.
derecho_death_dealer.core_identity: Mobile melee damage, necrotic lightning, corpse-powered storm effects, and magical weapon techniques.

legacy_merge.reason: The legacy package’s three paths (Rebellion Reaver, Prophetic Detonator, Soulimit Oracle) most closely support the new class’s weapon, hybrid, and full-caster expressions.

core_mechanics.apex_expression: become the eye of a death derecho, chaining weapon hits and soul-lightning between marked enemies

thundercoil_integration.training: Martial Thundercoils
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: When the Derecho activates a class feature through a charged Thundercoil strike, its necrotic and lightning effects may appear as a single supernatural discharge. Creatures defeated by these attacks can fuel its corpse-powered abilities, but the weapon still expends its normal charge.
notes: The Derecho Death Dealer channels necrotic storms through conductive weaponry. Its Sword supports fast spellblade combat and electrical parries, while its Axe excels when cutting through clustered enemies and harvesting power from defeated creatures.

The Shotgun gives the class a close-range storm burst for breaking formations before entering melee. A Derecho can treat the cyan discharge of a charged weapon as black, violet, corpse-blue, or grave-green lightning.

subclasses.name: Rebellion Reaver
subclasses.legacy_focus: cursed blades, soulfire fury, and close warbringing
subclasses.identity: A weapon-first path built from cursed blades, soulfire fury, and close warbringing. It has no spell slots and relies on standard D&D weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and deity-awarded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Rebellion Reaver Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and mark the target with corpse-static, preventing reactions until the start of its next turn. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Rebellion Reaver Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Rebellion Reaver Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of cursed blades, soulfire fury, and close warbringing.

features_by_level.name: Rebellion Reaver Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Rebellion Reaver Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per long rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

subclasses.name: Prophetic Detonator
subclasses.legacy_focus: midrange marks, chain explosions, and battlefield prediction
subclasses.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from midrange marks, chain explosions, and battlefield prediction. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Prophetic Detonator Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Necromancy, Evocation, Transmutation. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Prophetic Detonator Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a bonus action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses midrange marks, chain explosions, and battlefield prediction.

features_by_level.name: Prophetic Detonator Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Prophetic Detonator Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per long rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a bonus action.

subclasses.name: Soulimit Oracle
subclasses.legacy_focus: high-damage area prophecy and soulfire devastation
subclasses.identity: A dedicated magical path built from high-damage area prophecy and soulfire devastation. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Soulimit Oracle Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Necromancy, Evocation, Transmutation, Abjuration. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Soulimit Oracle Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has advantage. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Soulimit Oracle Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to high-damage area prophecy and soulfire devastation; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Soulimit Oracle Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per long rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

Its Hammer doubles as a crafting implement and defensive weapon. Its Rifle uses calculated trajectories and gravitational corrections, while its Shock-Bombs and Coil Arrays turn prepared terrain into a network of timed discharges.

mindknife_mirage.description: A psychic infiltrator who attacks thoughts, creates false perceptions, and manifests invisible or semi-real weapons.

covenant_aegis.core_identity: Shared defenses, damage interception, party-wide barriers, linked saving throws, retaliatory protection, and maintaining a formation under overwhelming pressure.

legacy_merge.reason: The legacy package’s three paths (Iron Reliquary, Candle Engine, Soulstorm Conductor) most closely support the new class’s weapon, hybrid, and full-caster expressions.

dnd_transition.guidance: These sources explain familiar play patterns for D&D players; they are inspirations, not additional selectable classes or subclasses in this homebrew roster.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Willing allies form Covenant Links that distribute protection, movement, saving throws, and retaliatory force through the group.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a sanctioned formation in which allies share barriers, movement, and recovery
core_mechanics.counter_expression: intercept harm through the covenant and redirect part of it into the attacker or reservoir
core_mechanics.apex_expression: unite the party into one sovereign defensive body with shared reactions and continuously renewing barriers

ichor_bounty.bounty_trigger: Protect a lawful bond, preserve inheritance or family continuity, reconcile a community without erasing its members, or uphold social order against predation.
ichor_bounty.deity_boon_expression: ivory-shadow Ichor that seals a voluntary covenant and stores intercepted harm in a shared reservoir

thundercoil_integration.training: Defensive melee weapons, close-control firearms, and emplacement systems
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: When the Aegis intercepts damage or moves to protect an ally, it may combine that reaction with an eligible charged Thundercoil strike when permitted by its class progression.
notes: The Covenant Aegis uses Thundercoils to interrupt attackers, deny reactions, force enemies away from allies, and defend fixed positions.

The Hammer is its signature Thundercoil because it supports non-lethal control, breaching, and forced movement. The Sword provides defensive parries, while the Shotgun protects doorways, corridors, and wounded companions.

subclasses.name: Iron Reliquary
subclasses.legacy_focus: durable interception, positional guarding, and retaliatory construct strikes
subclasses.identity: A weapon-first path built from durable interception, positional guarding, and retaliatory construct strikes. It has no spell slots and relies on standard D&D weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and deity-awarded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Iron Reliquary Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and extend a protective link to an ally and punish the target for attacking outside the formation. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Iron Reliquary Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Iron Reliquary Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of durable interception, positional guarding, and retaliatory construct strikes.

features_by_level.name: Iron Reliquary Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Iron Reliquary Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per long rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

rules_compliance.class_feature_attack_bonus: proficiency bonus + relevant attack or Charisma modifier
rules_compliance.action_economy: Features use only the action, bonus action, reaction, or movement they explicitly name.
rules_compliance.concentration: One concentration effect at a time.
rules_compliance.resource: Bounty Ichor is separate from spell slots and Thundercoil charges.

subclasses.name: Candle Engine
subclasses.legacy_focus: efficient healing, ward redistribution, and emergency stabilization
subclasses.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from efficient healing, ward redistribution, and emergency stabilization. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Candle Engine Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Abjuration, Enchantment, Evocation. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Candle Engine Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a bonus action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses efficient healing, ward redistribution, and emergency stabilization.

features_by_level.name: Candle Engine Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Candle Engine Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per long rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a bonus action.

subclasses.name: Soulstorm Conductor
subclasses.legacy_focus: ranged soul-light damage, reservoir bursts, and offensive support
subclasses.identity: A dedicated magical path built from ranged soul-light damage, reservoir bursts, and offensive support. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Soulstorm Conductor Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Abjuration, Enchantment, Evocation, Conjuration. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Soulstorm Conductor Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has advantage. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Soulstorm Conductor Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to ranged soul-light damage, reservoir bursts, and offensive support; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Soulstorm Conductor Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per long rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.
